payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates all possible second numbers 1..n, uses Euclidean algorithm (division) to compute steps backwards from (n,i) to (1,1), and takes the minimum steps.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a complete search over the second number, relying on the fact that the backward process is uniquely determined by the larger number and the chosen smaller one, akin to exploring all paths in the state graph but without explicit BFS/DFS.
